summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou infiltrate the Shen family dormitory to manipulate Shen Wei. Shen Feizhi aims to secure a research and development permit for his project (W.N.) by leveraging Shen Wei's insecurity regarding his position in the family and his rivalry with his cousin, Shen Jiang. Shen Feizhi successfully coerces Shen Wei into signing a contract by offering a 2% stake in the company and using high-pressure tactics. Gu Suizhou remains hidden under the bed, providing technical support and engaging in playful, clandestine physical contact with Shen Feizhi.
